name: Flat backdrop
summary: Flat vector full-frame background generator: outdoor sky/land or indoor room, with time of day and weather params.

params.name: setting
params.note: outdoor = sky, land and ground; indoor = wall, floor, window and lamp

params.name: time
params.note: lights the sky and every colour; night shows moon and stars

params.name: weather
params.note: greys the sky and adds animated rain, snow, fog or lightning (also seen through indoor windows)

params.name: land
params.note: outdoor only: what stands on the horizon

params.name: horizon
params.note: outdoor horizon y; ground starts about 280 px lower

params.name: groundColor
params.note: outdoor grass colour (snow weather turns it white; city land always gets a road)

params.name: floorY
params.note: indoor y where wall meets floor; stand characters a little below it

params.name: lamp
params.note: indoor: ceiling lamp (glows at dusk and night)

params.name: seed
params.note: varies cloud, hill, skyline and tree placement

params.name: anim
params.note: drift = clouds drift and trees sway from p.f; weather always animates

author: krakujs
